key.name: show-overdue
key.description: On today, list overdue tasks before today’s, as Todoist’s Today view does.

key.name: refresh-minutes
key.description: Minutes between task updates. Opening the date menu also updates, at most every 30 seconds.

key.name: token-serial
key.description: Bumped by Preferences when the API token in the keyring changes, so the extension re-reads it. Holds no secret.
